svg.title: 塔楼书房 · The Tower Study
svg.desc: A two-storey fairytale tower floating above a sea of clouds at dusk: a warm study upstairs, a witch's bedroom with a glowing moon lamp downstairs, a broom circling the tower, and petals, fireflies, leaves and snow drifting past as the seasons turn.

g.text: 两层楼 · 四季流转 · 十八个小发现
Two floors · Four seasons · Eighteen little discoveries
